app.name: Casa·Orquesta
app.tagline: Find your home by talking, not typing.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Casa·Orquesta
onboarding.subtitle: Your real-estate advisor, by voice.
onboarding.feature_search: Speak to find properties in Mexico City and Morelos.
onboarding.feature_audit: Verify titles and documents without paperwork.
onboarding.feature_schedule: Book showings with one tap and your voice.
onboarding.invite_subtitle: Casa·Orquesta is in closed beta. Enter the code you received via WhatsApp.
onboarding.phone_subtitle: We'll send a code via SMS to verify.
onboarding.otp_subtitle: We sent an SMS to {{phone}}. Enter the 6 digits.
onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Your account is ready. Casa·Orquesta is listening when you are.
onboarding.welcome_bullet_1: Press and hold the mic to speak.
onboarding.welcome_bullet_2: Tap a property to focus the next question.

invite_error.unknown_code: Code not found. Check it and try again.
invite_error.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite_error.already_redeemed: This code has already been used by someone else.

otp_error.409: This code was already used. Go back to the previous step.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.subtitle: We need your consent to process your voice and show personalized results.
consent.mic_label: I allow the app to use the microphone only when I activate it.
consent.transcripts_label: I accept that conversations may be transcribed to improve the service.
consent.scroll_to_continue: Scroll to the end to enable Accept.
consent.voice_hint: You can also say "yes" / "no" or "acepto" / "no acepto".
consent.footer: You can withdraw your consent at any time from Settings.

home.prompt: Speak whenever you're ready. I'm listening.
home.empty_feed: Tell me what kind of home you're looking for and I'll show options.

threads.title: Clients
threads.subtitle: Each client has their own history and results.
threads.empty_subtitle: Create a client to save their search, history, and results.
threads.rename_hint: Rename active client (press Enter to save)
threads.delete_last_hint: You can delete this client and start a new one.

visit.title: Schedule a visit
visit.subtitle: We propose three times coordinated with the agent and owner. Pick what works best.
visit.confirmed_body: We'll notify you on WhatsApp 24 h and 2 h before.
visit.error_confirm: Couldn't confirm the slot. Try again.

clientProfile.title: Client profile
clientProfile.subtitle: Fill in the main criteria so the locator agent can find properties aligned with budget, credit, area, and desired features.
clientProfile.listing_mode_hint: Select whether the client is buying or renting (annual lease)
clientProfile.budget_hint: Demo estimate to profile buying capacity. Percentages adjust automatically by credit type and can be edited.
clientProfile.budget_pending: Add budget or target value to calculate costs.
clientProfile.credit_hint: Record the credit broker and pre-approval follow-up tied to the consumer agreement.
clientProfile.credit_broker_ph: e.g. Gerardo Hernández / BBVA broker desk
clientProfile.preapproval_notes_ph: e.g. Missing income proof; call broker Tuesday...
clientProfile.consumer_agreement: The client authorized sharing financial data and credit follow-up with the broker under the consumer agreement.
clientProfile.notes_ph: e.g. Near schools, public transit, ideal for young family...
clientProfile.thread_empty: Complete this client's profile to narrow voice and chat searches.

listing.audit_hint: One tap runs RPP, Catastro, and INEGI checks. Results appear in the feed below.

followup.lead: Pick an action. Each one is sent to chat so the orchestrator can coordinate follow-up.
followup.message_hint: Draft a new message for this contact.
followup.call_hint: Callable action to start or prepare a call.
followup.schedule_hint: Calendar with availability and simulated sync.
followup.calendars_synced: Calendars synced: buyer · agent · broker · Casa·Orquesta
followup.detail_hint: Contact selected. Use the actions below or say what follow-up you need.

cards.demo_catalog_hint: Sample property for the pilot. Live rentals appear after Inmuebles24 sync; imported inventory is mostly for-sale today.
cards.saved_subtitle: Matches you saved for this client.

permissions.mic_rationale: To talk to Casa·Orquesta we need microphone access. It only activates when you ask.
permissions.notifications_rationale: We notify you when a showing is confirmed or when there are updates on a property.
